prompt: This loop is meant to print every element. What does it actually do?
choices: Prints 20, 30 - it starts one element too late
Prints nothing - the condition is false immediately
explanation: Indices run from 0 to length - 1, so the last valid index here is 2. Using <= length lets i reach 3, and values[3] does not exist. The loop prints all three elements first and then throws, which is why this bug often looks like it works until the very end.
hints: What is the largest index a three-element array has?
Work out the last value i takes, and ask whether that index exists.
